features.name: Stop a reply partway
features.summary: Type stop, or press Stop under the reply, while your agent is working; what it already finished stays done and nothing more happens.
features.where: In the chat, the Stop button under the reply while your agent is working.
how: While your agent is working, press Stop, or send a message that says only stop.
limits: Stopping does not undo what is already done, such as a row written or a draft made.
Typing cancel does not stop it.
On a shared agent, only the owner's stop stops it.
features.phone: Archie Mobile has a Stop button too, and a message that says only stop works from a chat app.
trust: ✅ Stopping a reply partway by typing stop or pressing Stop, in Archie and in Archie Mobile, and a phone message that waits for a sleeping computer: SHIPPED in Archie 0.3.5 on October 5, 2026, and in Archie Mobile on Android in the same release and on iPhone in 1.1
features.wording: Changed your mind while your agent is working? Type stop, or press Stop, in Archie or in Archie Mobile. What it already finished stays done, and nothing more happens.

features.name: Tables and checklists in replies
features.summary: In Archie, your agent can answer with a table or a checklist when that is the clearer shape, and links and code show properly.
features.where: In the chat.
limits: Your agent writes a table only when every screen reading the conversation can draw one.
On Discord, Signal and iMessage your agent writes labeled lists instead of tables.
features.phone: On a chat app, Matrix draws a table, Telegram and Slack show it as a labeled list, and Discord, Signal and iMessage get a list instead.
trust: 🚧 Pictures, videos, recordings, and documents both ways, and replies with tables, in Archie and in the app: BUILT 2026-09-25, the computer's half in Archie 0.3.1 (released September 29, 2026), the app's half on Android in 0.3.5's download (October 5, 2026) and on iPhone in 1.0 (October 7, 2026), whose picker could not choose a document until 1.1
features.wording: Send your agent a photo, a few at once, a video, a recording, or a document, from Archie on your computer or from the Archie app on your phone. It looks at the pictures, asks before it watches a video or listens to a recording, and reads the document. It sends files back the same way, and in Archie it can answer with a table or a checklist when that is the clearer shape.

features.name: New chat
features.summary: Press New chat and your agent starts fresh. It forgets the conversation and keeps what it has learned about you.
features.where: At the top of an agent's Chat, beside Search and Copy chat. A New chat line in the conversation marks where it began.
how: Open your agent's Chat.
Press New chat.
Press Start a new chat.
limits: The messages stay on screen to scroll back through. It is your agent that forgets them.
Any change your agent offered that you have not said yes to is dropped. Email drafts, reminders, and to-do ticks keep their buttons.
Only while the agent is running, and only in your own conversation.
Chat apps have no button. Typing /new there does the same thing.
features.phone: In Archie Mobile, press the New chat button at the top right of the Chat tab. Its chat also marks where each day begins. On a chat app, type /new.
trust: ✅ New chat: starting over with one press, in Archie and in Archie Mobile, with a line where each day and each new chat begins: BUILT 2026-10-10, RELEASED in 0.3.8, 2026-10-11, the Archie Mobile half on iPhone in 1.3 (not on Android yet)
features.wording: Press New chat and your agent starts fresh. It forgets the conversation and keeps what it has learned about you.

features.name: Question cards keep their buttons
features.summary: The cards where your agent offers choices keep working for two weeks, even after Archie restarts, so a card from Friday still answers on Monday.
features.where: Under your agent's replies in Chat.
limits: A reply draft's buttons last a day.
A conversation keeps its twenty newest cards. Pressing an older one gets "That's no longer current. Just tell me what you'd like."
Offers to watch a video somebody sent, or to import a file dropped in the chat, come off when the agent restarts.
New chat takes off the buttons only the cleared conversation could answer.
features.phone: Archie Mobile shows the same cards and buttons.
trust: ✅ New chat: starting over with one press, in Archie and in Archie Mobile, with a line where each day and each new chat begins: BUILT 2026-10-10, RELEASED in 0.3.8, 2026-10-11, the Archie Mobile half on iPhone in 1.3 (not on Android yet)

features.name: What your agent saved and looked at
features.summary: Under a reply, Archie says what your agent saved to your lists, with Open and Undo, and what it read to answer.
features.where: Under your agent's reply in Chat.
how: Press Open to see the list at that entry.
Press Undo to take a save back, or Undo all when there were several.
limits: It names saves to your lists, and reads of lists, documents, the calendar, mail, and Drive. Mail and Drive are named only by count.
It does not name reminders it set, calendar changes, mail it drafted or sent, or web searches. The Jobs tab is the full record.
The Read line names what each read returned, whether or not the answer used it. Press a list on it to open that list on just those entries.
When every list it read is empty, it says the answer is not from your records.
features.phone: Archie Mobile shows the same line with Undo, and its Open goes to Lists. Chat apps show none of it.
trust: ✅ Under a reply, what your agent saved and what it read, with Open and Undo, and What it keeps at the top of Knowledge: BUILT 2026-10-10, RELEASED in 0.3.8, 2026-10-11
features.wording: When your agent saves something to one of your lists, Archie says so under its reply, like Saved in Rentals: Harlan Remodeling, with Open to see the list and Undo to take it back. It also names what it looked at to answer and how much, like Rentals: 1 of 14 or Calendar (3 events). When every list it looked at is empty, Archie says that too: Your Rentals list is empty, so this is not from your records. At the top of the agent's Knowledge tab, What it keeps says how many lists, documents and things about you it has, and shows the latest changes to your lists, each with Undo.

features.name: Ask your agent ordinary questions
features.summary: Your agent answers ordinary questions the way any AI chat does, such as how to word a hard email, in the same conversation as everything else it does.
features.where: On your agent's Chat tab.
limits: It can get things wrong. Archie says so under the message box: Archie can get things wrong. Check before you act on it.
Your question goes to your AI company, the same as every message.
Where an answer needs a file or a live fact, it prefers to look it up.
A brand new agent's first messages are its setup questions.
features.phone: It answers the same way on your chat app and in Archie Mobile.
trust: ✅ It answers ordinary questions too, the way any AI chat does (entry written 2026-09-18)
features.wording: Your agent answers ordinary questions the same way any AI chat you have used does: how to word a hard email, what a letter actually means, what to cook with what is in the fridge. Same conversation as everything else it does.

features.name: Your agent looks back through your conversation
features.summary: Your agent keeps the last twenty messages in front of it. Ask about something from further back and it searches your conversation for it.
limits: It searches the last 500 messages of your own conversation with that agent, and nothing older.
It matches words, so a question worded differently from what was said can miss. Then your agent says it no longer has it.
Only your own conversation. A guest's or a teammate's chat is never searched, and routines do not get it.
features.phone: Something you said on your chat app or in Archie Mobile is found the same way as something typed at your desk.
trust: ✅ It can look back through your conversation for something you told it: BUILT 2026-09-25 (Archie `69b2e4ed` and `dd154236`), SHIPPED in Archie 0.3.1 on September 29, 2026
features.wording: Your agent keeps the last twenty messages in front of it. Ask about something from further back and it can search your conversation for it, the same conversation you can scroll back through in Archie.

features.name: Search this chat
features.summary: Type a word or a name and Archie shows every message in your chat with an agent that has all of them, newest first. Press one to go to it.
features.where: On your agent's Chat tab, press Search at the top, or press Command F (Control F on Windows).
how: On your agent's Chat tab, press Search, or press Command F.
Type a word or a name.
Press a match to go to it in the chat.
limits: It covers the newest 500 messages a chat keeps. When nothing matches, the box says how far back the chat goes.
It matches the words you type, so "plumber" does not find "the guy who fixed the sink".
It searches your chat with that agent only. Email, files, and anybody else's chat are never searched.
On a team, each person's search covers only their own chat.
features.phone: In Archie Mobile, the magnifying glass at the top of the Chat tab opens the same search, and an older match opens in the box.
trust: 🚧 Search this chat, on the computer and the phone, done in code with no AI: BUILT 2026-10-18 (Archie `e35220a1`, archie-mobile `434bc3d`), RELEASED in 0.3.11, 2026-10-19, the Archie Mobile half on iPhone in 1.4 (not on Android yet)
features.wording: Search your chat with an agent for anything either of you said. Type a word or a name and Archie shows every message that has all of them, newest first, with the day it was said. Press one and the chat goes to it. It works the same on Archie Mobile, and on a team, each person's search covers only their own chat.

features.name: Charts in the conversation
features.summary: Ask for a chart and your agent draws it in the conversation as bars, a line or a pie, with the numbers on it.
features.where: In the chat on your agent's Chat tab.
how: Ask your agent for a chart, for example "Chart my sales by month."
limits: Three kinds: bars, a line, and a pie, one set of numbers each. A pie with more than five slices, or a number at or below zero, is drawn as bars.
On Telegram, Slack, Discord, Matrix and iMessage it comes as a short list of the numbers.
A chart is as right as the numbers your agent put in it. Copy gives the numbers, and there is no saving it as a picture.
There is nothing to press or zoom. On the computer, resting the pointer on a crowded line shows a hidden figure.
features.phone: Archie Mobile draws the same chart, and a chat app such as Telegram gets a short list of the numbers.
trust: 🚧 Charts drawn in the conversation, in Archie and in Archie Mobile, and the same numbers as a list on a chat app: BUILT 2026-10-18 (Archie `2234ec0c`, archie-mobile `cfb2bf9`), RELEASED in 0.3.11, 2026-10-19, the Archie Mobile half on iPhone in 1.4 (not on Android yet)
✅ What your agent can write to disk
features.wording: Ask for a chart and your agent draws it in the conversation: bars, a line or a pie, with the numbers on it. It shows the same in Archie on your computer and in Archie Mobile on your phone. On a chat app like Telegram it sends the same numbers as a short list.

features.name: The Today line over the message box

features.where: Over the message box, in your chat with your agent.
how: Press the line to open the list.

Past 25 in one part, the rest are on the Jobs tab. Undo shows only where the Jobs tab has it.
A teammate's phone does not show the line.

features.name: Not now, answered at once
features.summary: Press Not now, No thanks, Skip or Cancel under something your agent offered, and Archie answers "Okay, left it." right away, without asking the AI, and drops what the card offered.
features.where: Under a card or a question your agent sent, in your chat with it.
how: Press Not now, No thanks, Skip or Cancel under the offer.
limits: Only a press that just says no. A plain No that answers a question, or a no with more in it, like "Not now, remind me Friday", still goes to your agent.
Anything else waiting for your yes in that chat is dropped too, as your agent's own reply would drop it.
Any other button is a message like one you typed, and your agent answers it.
Not during your agent's first questions, whose buttons are answers about you.
features.phone: A press in Archie Mobile is answered the same way by the computer, and the answer reaches your phone like any reply.
